description: Find a verified insurance agent or intermediary. q is a firm name, CoR (e.g. CA0001), an individual licence number (zero-padded to 6 digits: 001739 not 1739), an agent ID or a PIN. Returns firms in agents[] and people in individuals[]. A licence number is fetched live if we do not hold it yet. kind is a firm slug (corporate-agents, brokers, tpas, imfs, web-aggregators, surveyors, repositories, telemarketers). state is a state slug (tamil-nadu). Phone and e-mail are masked. A miss is not proof the agent is unregistered.
